scope.purpose: Freeze the single primary H4 control intervention and its nominal direct-DAE check before IAS26-060.
scope.experiment_limit: One canonical nominal H4 DAE evaluation at g=0.25 only. No parameter sweep, Monte Carlo, eta/M2/M3, GFM, or poster-figure generation.
scope.m1_dependency: None for the direct DAE eigenvalue comparison. IAS26-010 remains BLOCKED_M1_STRICT; no reduced-root prediction or validation is permitted.

unchanged_parameters.network_loads_dispatch_locations_ratings: identical to frozen P4 IEEE-39 TX4 source

primary_intervention.name: fixed_QV_retuning
primary_intervention.selection_basis: pre-existing canonical g sweep; fixed by IAS26-050, not optimized on development or holdout scenarios

treatment.paired_comparison: Same frozen IEEE-39 network, loads, dispatch, H4 locations, ratings, and all non-g controller/model parameters.

metrics_and_decisions.primary_metric: alpha_perp: spectral abscissa over the complete transverse spectrum of the direct DAE linearization
metrics_and_decisions.secondary_metric: alpha_Omega: rightmost transverse eigenvalue restricted to 0.3-1.5 Hz; report separately and never substitute for alpha_perp
metrics_and_decisions.tau_dec_source: F1 preregistered renderer BOUNDARY_TOLERANCE=1e-8 at source commit a042efd7156a505928c52b9a373aa0839371f32b; unchanged

nominal_pre_run_prediction.metric: alpha_Omega at the dominant target-band eigenvalue, direct DAE
nominal_pre_run_prediction.source: baseline TX4_CONTEXTUAL_RETURN_SWEEP.csv, exact rows g=0.03625 and g=0.25; full DAE transverse operator, target-band eigenvalue only
nominal_pre_run_prediction.important_scope: This numeric prediction is alpha_Omega, not a prediction of complete-spectrum delta alpha_perp. The new nominal check must retain the full transverse spectrum and determine alpha_perp directly.

valid_only_if: frozen tx4_case DAE solve returns successfully
equilibrium and complete transverse spectrum are finite
max absolute differential and algebraic equilibrium residuals are each <= 1e-7, matching baseline G2
nominal_feasibility.if_invalid: Mark intervention nominal check BLOCKED/INVALID; do not retune, relax thresholds, or claim rescue.

metrics_and_decisions.mode_identity: Retain complete eigenvalues/eigenvectors at both canonical g values where available; report alpha_perp and alpha_Omega separately. Do not claim a tracked mode-family transition from eigenvalue ordering alone.
metrics_and_decisions.failure_and_replacement: No silent case substitution. Nominal failure remains visible. IAS26-060 must assign every pre-generated scenario ID a result or auditable failure code; no post-hoc draw replacement.

explicitly_not_frozen_here.mc_operational_distribution_P_L_Q_L_P_G_: IAS26-060 pre-run configuration; execution prohibited until fully specified
explicitly_not_frozen_here.mc_seed_and_1000_scenario_ids: IAS26-060 pre-run configuration; generation and hash must precede any MC evaluation
explicitly_not_frozen_here.full_spectrum_alpha_perp_at_g_0_25: measured only by the single preregistered nominal direct-DAE verification launched after this config is frozen
